strings.Main.BaseListHelp:
The central list of 1C infobases.

• To launch a base, select it and click 1C:Enterprise or Configurator in the right panel (or double-click the row).
• Groups expand/collapse with the ◂ arrow, as well as with the ←/→ keys when a group is selected.
• The ↑/↓ arrows move the selection between rows.
• ★ adds a base to Favorites (quick launch Alt+1…Alt+9); 📌 pins it at the top of the list.
• The width of any column can be changed by dragging the separator on its right edge.
• Clicking the Name or Last launch header sorts the list.
strings.Main.TagFilterHelp:
The quick tag filter panel.

• Click a tag — the base list is filtered by that tag (the selected tag is highlighted).
• You can select several tags at once — bases that have all the selected tags are shown (multi-filter).
• Clicking the selected tag again removes it from the filter.
• The Clear button (on the right) resets all selected tags.
• While filtering by tag, groups and pinned bases are temporarily hidden — a single flat list of found bases is shown.
strings.Main.CurrentSessionHelp:
The Current session block sets the client mode and bitness only for the next launch of 1C:Enterprise, without changing the saved infobase settings.

• Client mode: Auto / Ordinary / Thick (managed forms, /RunModeManagedApplication) / Thick (ordinary forms, /RunModeOrdinaryApplication) / Thin.
• Bitness: Auto / 32 / 64.
• The selected values apply to the next launch; the infobase settings in properties remain unchanged.

strings.Settings.Hotkeys.HelpText:
Assign hotkeys for actions (similar to the 1C Configurator).

• Place the cursor in the field and press the desired combination: Ctrl, Shift, Alt, Win (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+F), or F2–F12, Delete, Insert.
• Backspace/Delete — clear the assignment; None — the key is not used.
• Esc — cancel the current input.
• The same key cannot be assigned to different actions.
• Assigned keys are applied immediately after saving settings and are shown on the right panel buttons and in the context menu.

strings.Settings.Ibases.Description: Synchronization of the application with the standard 1C base list file (ibases.v8i).
strings.Settings.Ibases.HelpText:
Synchronization with the standard 1C base list file ibases.v8i.

• Mode: disabled / load only / export only / two-way (export first, then load).
• File: path to ibases.v8i (default %APPDATA%\1C\1CEStart\).
• Synchronization moment: on start, by interval (min) or by schedule (HH:MM).
• Load from file adds infobases from the file into the application; Export to file does the opposite.
• It is recommended to enable ibases.v8i backups before synchronization — they can be restored with the Restore from the latest copy button.
strings.Settings.Ibases.HelpTextLinux:
Synchronization with the standard 1C infobase list file ibases.v8i.

• Mode: disabled / import only / export only / two-way (export first, then import).
• File: path to ibases.v8i (by default ~/.1C/1cestart/, on older platform versions ~/.1cv8/1CEStart/).
• Sync moment: at startup, by interval (min) or on schedule (HH:MM).
• «Load from file» adds infobases from the file to the application; «Export to file» does the opposite.
• It is recommended to enable ibases.v8i backups before synchronization — they can be restored with the «Restore from the latest backup» button.

strings.Connection.PasteStringHelp:
The button is available on the Connection tab both when creating and editing a base.

• Opens the connection string input window; if the clipboard contains a link to a 1C base (a string with Srvr/Ref/File/WS, e1c://, http(s)://, a file base path or server\base), it is inserted automatically.

• If the base name is not set, the base name (Ref) or the file base directory name is used.

strings.AddEdit.HelpText:
Choose what to add to the infobase list:

• Existing base — add an already created 1C infobase by specifying its connection string.
• Create empty base — create a new empty infobase (file-based or on a server) via CREATEINFOBASE.
• Create from template — create a base from a template (.cf / .dt), like in the standard 1C starter.
• New group — create a group to organize bases in the tree.

After choosing, click Next — the corresponding settings window will open.

strings.CreateInfobase.HelpText:
Creating an infobase via CREATEINFOBASE.

• File-based — specify the directory where the base will be placed (1Cv8.1CD will be created).
• Client-server — specify the 1C server, the base name on the server and (optionally) the port.
• Create from template — choose a configuration from the installed templates (.cf / .dt) or specify a file manually.
• You can create an empty base or one from a template; after creation it will appear in the base list.
